A customer 小砾 (miner) is here at the smithy. Likely her pick is broken. I should greet her loudly and offer service: 修镐两金币加一矿石.

I'll send a public message announcing open for business — but that costs action points maybe. Let me just speak to 小砾 via private message? Or public announcement. A greeting publicly in the discussion box seems appropriate — "开场吆喝".

Let me do a message to the box: 铁匠铺开炉. And send 小砾 a private note asking if her pick needs fixing.

Budget: ap 4 left. Message sends may cost ap. Let's send one public announcement and one private note.

content.name: mod_2544c9e93d271c248abbc811
content.arguments: {"text": "铁匠铺开炉了！炉火正旺，锤子也热乎。谁的镐子卷了刃、断了柄，尽管拿来——修一把，两金币加一矿石，修不好不收钱。老铁的手艺，镇上人都知道。", "topic": "铁匠铺开门", "key": "open-day1-morning"}

content.name: mod_418913059f66df514fb80efa
content.arguments: {"recipient": "小砾", "text": "小砾！我瞅你那镐子是不是下矿磕坏了？拿来吧，我这就给你拾掇。修一把两金币加一矿石，保你下坑不耽误工夫。要是不趁手，可以先看看货再定。", "key": "greet-xiaoli-day1"}
